# fw-material crate

> Material Symbols SVG path data and codepoints as Rust constants, generated by tools/material-cdn and served from the Aphrody CDN, with a checksum-pinned…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-material/

Material Symbols SVG path data and codepoints as Rust constants, generated by tools/material-cdn and served from the Aphrody CDN, with a checksum-pinned tarball and an offline vendored fallback.
